target.name: Shopify
target.description: Shopify theme adapter using Liquid templates, generated token wrapper, copied CSS assets, and shared progressive-enhancement JavaScript.

policy.tokenOwnership: tokens.css is generated from platforms/web/tokens.css and should not be edited directly.
policy.baseOwnership: base.css is generated from reset, foundations, and utilities source CSS; it must not define token values.
policy.componentCssOwnership: Component CSS assets are copied from components/css and should be regenerated from source.
policy.runtimeDelivery: runtime-loader.js imports only the progressive-enhancement modules matched by rendered Liquid; theme.js remains a compatibility and diagnostic aggregate.
policy.liquidOwnership: Liquid files are Shopify adapter source and may map Shopify objects/settings into component contracts.
policy.maturityOwnership: Shopify maturity is computed from contract status, CSS output, Liquid evidence, section/block schema, data mapping, template composition, editor-preview readiness, and behavior requirements. Class-level contracts do not require dedicated Liquid roots.
policy.distribution: Consumer Shopify themes copy and own the generated adapter files locally.

strategies.embedded-class-contract: Reusable CSS/anatomy contract applied inside any Liquid context; no dedicated Liquid root is required.
strategies.dedicated-liquid-template: Shopify-specific markup is expected but has not been detected yet.
strategies.section-adapter: Merchant-editable Shopify section with Liquid, schema/settings, data mapping, template composition, and editor preview support.
strategies.theme-block-adapter: Future merchant-editable Shopify theme block with its own Liquid and schema.
strategies.snippet-adapter: Reusable Liquid snippet rendered by sections/templates with explicit data/render parameters.
strategies.layout-adapter: Shopify layout-level adapter for global shells and sections.

layers.css: Required for every component and satisfied by generated/copied Shopify CSS assets.
layers.liquid: Required for dedicated Shopify adapters; embedded class contracts may be implemented without a detected Liquid root.
layers.schema: Required for section and theme-block adapters; validates that target-native editor settings exist in Liquid schema.
layers.data: Required for dedicated Shopify adapters; tracks Shopify objects, settings, render calls, section calls, and snippet render parameters.
layers.behavior: Required when the contract defines behavior; accepted only when the Shopify adapter status is implemented.
layers.templateComposition: Required for section adapters; satisfied by JSON templates, layout section calls, or addable section presets.
layers.editorPreview: Required for section and theme-block adapters; checks that schema controls are wired into rendered Liquid instead of becoming dead editor controls.

contractAdapter.notes: Shopify Liquid can render native button or anchor elements with the same class contract.
Shopify Liquid can render labels, native input elements, form attributes, and validation messages with the same class contract.
Shopify renders native select markup and the shared theme.js progressively enhances it without changing submitted values.
Shopify Liquid renders native textarea elements, form attributes, and the input__field/textarea__field class composition.
Shopify renders native checkbox markup and the shared theme.js progressively initializes mixed state.
Shopify Liquid can render product, order, inventory, or marketing badges with the same class contract.
Shopify may use a named button for client-owned filters or a target-native link when removal is navigation.
Dedicated Liquid maps product money filters, localized labels, native compare-at semantics, and Shopify's unit-price measurement filter.
Shopify Liquid can render the quantity control and target JavaScript should synchronize cart quantity changes.
Dedicated Liquid maps Shopify Rating metadata and localized count text without owning aggregation or review-provider policy.
Dedicated snippet maps icon, title, message, and Link action and requires a validated target-supplied heading_tag. Main cart and 404 use H1; the cart drawer uses H3 under its H2 dialog title.

Testimonials embeds the generated class around a Shopify image object and visible adjacent author name. Shopify remains responsible for choosing image or pre-derived initials; neutral Avatar owns no loading/error lifecycle.
Shopify Liquid can render semantic containers with card classes.
Shopify Liquid can render modal structure while theme JavaScript controls visibility and focus behavior.
Shopify Liquid can render drawer structure while theme JavaScript controls visibility and focus behavior.
Liquid can emit APG Button markup or native details; theme behavior owns optional group coordination.
The Shopify snippet renders the same nav, ordered-list, item, link, separator, and current-page class contract.
Liquid maps brand, menu, actions, and cart data, but shared search/cart/mobile runtime and action priority remain target work.
The existing Theme section maps merchant rich text to the canonical static mode. Countdown, rotation and controlled dismissal remain explicit target maturity work rather than copied behavior.
Current Liquid maps brand copy and menu blocks, but modern section-group placement remains an owner-level target decision; newsletter, locale, social, and legal composition are not inferred.
